t: This is the Royal London Hospital for Integrated Medicine in Bloomsbury, next to Great Ormond Street Hospital. It's part of University College London Hospitals and is the largest public sector provider of complementary medicine in Europe. Several people died here, including the Russian-born soprano Oda Slobodskaya, who became a British citizen, and the anarchist John Humphrey. The poet and community leader Dabirul Islam Choudhury also died here, as did twelve-year-old Archie Battersbee, whose care became the subject of a legal case in England.
